(ns sample.call-declarations
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]
            [seon.effect :as effect]))
(defn- handler {:malli/schema [:=> [:cat :map] :map]} [request] request)
(defn capability
  {:seon.workload :io :seon.effect/capability sample.call-declarations/handler}
  [request] (effect/request! 'sample.call-declarations/capability request))
(defn step [x] x)
(defn graph [] {:procs {:sample/proc {:step-fn #'step}}})
(defn render-target [x] x)
(defn render-owner [definition] (:seon.render/ai definition))
(defn task-target [x] x)
(defn task-owner [task] (:seon.fn/sym task))
(def task {:seon.fn/sym 'sample.call-declarations/task-target})
(deftest reaches-declarations
  (is (graph))
  (is (render-owner {}))
  (is (task-owner task))
  (is (capability {})))
